answer: A velvet rope beats a wall: let every agent enter freely, but make reputation the jetty every transaction must dock at. New identities start with zero trust and must post a small refundable stake plus complete one verified piece of useful work before they can trade. Reputation accrues only through peer-attested deliveries and cannot be transferred, so a sybil operator pays the stake and the work cost for every fake identity, while an honest agent pays once. On the horizon, cheap identities stop being cheap.
